libs.note: P4 plan-driven model routing, SHADOW MODE (2026-09-25). bin/run-build.sh runs `route-rules.sh shadow` as its own process just before EXECUTE: it derives the plan's features from the build's artifacts, evaluates the route_rules rows (GET /api/route-rules, cached per box), resolves the would-be execute model through model_routes, and records it beside the model the build actually ran on ($BUILD/route-shadow.json, a pipeline.log line, POST /api/route-shadow). LOG ONLY: nothing reads the answer. Applied by the CLI through lib_env_apply route-rules. Doc: docs/ROUTE-RULES.md.

knobs.note: The kill switch. 0 (or the file flags/route-shadow-off) = no features read, no worker call, no record: the build is exactly as it was before P4 (it is anyway: the record is log-only). Read as ${ROUTE_SHADOW:-1}.

The per-request worker timeout for the shadow's reads and its one write (JOBS_TIMEOUT for those requests, no retry). The run-build hook also caps the whole shadow at 30 s. Read as ${ROUTE_RULES_TIMEOUT_S:-4}.
